name: agent-ide
description: Agent IDE coding-companion skill: find a symbol address, read the symbol, replace it or edit lines inside it, with the ide.start/diff/inspect/stop/edit/outline/read/symbol/graph/test tools.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded ide.* workflow for active-session source edits
interface.longDescription: Ten ide.* tools (start, diff, inspect, stop, edit, outline, read, symbol, graph, test): symbol cards/positional lookup, graph call chains, inspect file diagnostics/check problems. Native fallback remains available.
